corpusFindings.井底蝦蟆: Impossible frog-at-bottom-of-well deployments include swallowing the moon and flying upward; preserve the narrow-view scene and do not merge the different predicates into hidden symbolism.
corpusFindings.紅爐片雪: A snowflake entering a red-hot furnace disappears without residue; exclude biographical mentions of the named case unless the phrase is deployed.
corpusFindings.火裏蓮: A lotus growing in fire is an impossible flourishing image used in answers and rank verses; distinguish exact phrase from longer 火裏蓮華 forms during selection.
corpusFindings.碓嘴生花: The pestle-tip flowers as an impossible event, repeatedly raised in teaching-seat sayings and Buddha-birthday addresses.
corpusFindings.河裏失錢河裏摝: If money was lost in the river, search for it in that river; the phrase is repeatedly an exact answer and later raised case.
corpusFindings.好肉剜瘡: Cutting a wound into sound flesh is adding injury where no wound existed; later comments use it against unnecessary explanation or formulation.
corpusFindings.平地喫交: Falling on level ground is failure without an external obstacle; actor work must separate the person being judged from the later commentator uttering the phrase.
corpusFindings.平地起骨堆: Raising a bone heap on level ground is manufacturing obstruction or debris where the ground was clear.
corpusFindings.賊是家親: The thief is family: the danger is intimate rather than an outside intruder; preserve Caoshan recensions as one deployment family.
corpusFindings.家賊難防: A household thief is hard to guard against because the thief is already inside; link but do not merge with 賊是家親.
